rationale: C04 is the closest because it also uses an operative suspension of legal limitations, but that is only a generic suspension mechanism applied to a different subject. C19 concerns military punishments and courts-martial, yet it preserves rather than suspends punishment limits and does not display parallel operative machinery. C24 likewise suspends statutory provisions but supplies no distinctive language or structure linking it to the later directive. The supplied material therefore does not show that any candidate furnished a concrete, material drafting template.
